page_title: ATA 1-2 BOL | Atalanta v Bologna 03/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
90+4' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) heads on.
90+3' Isak Hien (Atalanta) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
90+2' Emil Holm (Atalanta) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
90+2' One of the players from Bologna times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Federico La Penna who sees an offensive foul.
89' Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
89' Here is a change. Matteo Ruggeri is going off and Gian Piero Gasperini gives the last tactical orders to Isak Hien (Atalanta).
88' Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
87' Substitution. Michel Aebischer (Bologna) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Dan Ndoye walks off.
86' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the left side of the goal, but Marco Carnesecchi makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
85' 12:10 – the total goal attempt statistics.
83' Lukasz Skorupski (Bologna) sends a long ball forward to Jens Odgaard, but he put too much power and the chance is gone.
81' Substitution. Joshua Zirkzee makes way for Jens Odgaard (Bologna).
80' The free kick from the edge of the box is taken by Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta), but he hits it straight in the defensive wall.

79' It looks like Remo Freuler (Bologna) saw red with that tackle. Federico La Penna won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Free kick. Atalanta will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
79' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
78' Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
77' Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
77' The resulting corner from Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) comes to nothing.
77' The free kick from close range, taken by Atalanta, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

76' Remo Freuler (Bologna) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Federico La Penna blows his whistle for a foul. Atalanta win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
75' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
75' A cross by Emil Holm (Atalanta) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball is out of play. Atalanta win a corner kick.
74' Atalanta keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
73' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) has an effort from distance but it's blocked.
73' Emil Holm (Atalanta) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.

72' A bullet header by Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) from inside the box has the power, but goes totally in the wrong direction, yards over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bologna.
71' Good work from Atalanta as they win a corner.

71' Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Atalanta.
69' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Ederson (Atalanta) was quite harsh and Federico La Penna didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
68' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) but poses no threat.
66' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to substitute Giorgio Scalvini and he is replaced by Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta).
66' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Charles De Ketelaere.
64' Emil Holm (Atalanta) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
64' Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
62' Gian Piero Gasperini prepares a substitution. Mario Pasalic is replaced by Ederson (Atalanta).
62' We are about to witness a substitution. Emil Holm (Atalanta) is replacing Davide Zappacosta.

61' 1 - 2 Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) quickly gets to a rebound. He is not worried how far out he is and slams the ball towards the goal. To the amazement of all, it goes all the way into the bottom left corner. He makes it 1:2 with this magnificent strike.
60' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) fires the ball from distance, but it's blocked by a defender.
57' 1 - 1 Goal! Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) puts the ball into the bottom right corner past the outstretched arm of Marco Carnesecchi.
57' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) is going to take the penalty!
57' A player from Atalanta commits a rough challenge. Federico La Penna blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. PENALTY to Bologna! Great chance to score.
56' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Giovanni Fabbian as he is replaced by Kacper Urbanski (Bologna).

55' Riccardo Calafiori (Bologna) wastes a great chance from the resulting corner. He times his header superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross, but can't aim better than into the middle of the goal, straight into the arms of the goalkeeper.
54' Riccardo Calafiori (Bologna) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.
53' The linesman points to the corner flag, Bologna are going to take it.
52' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Ademola Lookman (Atalanta). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
50' Federico La Penna has a clear sight and sees a foul from Marten de Roon (Atalanta).
49' Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
48' Sam Beukema (Bologna) delivers a long cross in an attempt to surprise the opponent's sleepy defence.
46' Thiago Motta has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Alexis Saelemaekers comes on the pitch for Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna).
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Stefan Posch (Bologna) is replaced by Jhon Lucumi.
46' The whistle blows and Federico La Penna starts the second half.
45+1' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
44' Sam Beukema (Bologna) is penalised for a foul. Federico La Penna had a clear view and blows his whistle.
43' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Teun Koopmeiners.
42' A dangerous looking corner kick from Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) is cleared to safety by the defence.
42' The corner is swung in but Atalanta can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. Atalanta have been awarded a corner kick.
42' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The referee signals a corner kick to Atalanta.
40' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
39' Ball possession – 47:53.
38' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Atalanta comes to nothing.
37' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked. The ball is out of play. Atalanta will have a chance to score from a corner.
35' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
33' An attempted cross from Stefan Posch (Bologna) is cleared.
32' Stefan Posch (Bologna) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
30' Remo Freuler (Bologna) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
28' 1 - 0 Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) takes an advantage of chaos in the goalmouth and easily scores from a rebound.
28' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Lukasz Skorupski stops the ball from going inside right post.
28' Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) is able to continue to play.
27' Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) picks up an injury.
25' Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) attempts to send a defence-splitting pass in order to find free space for his teammate.
25' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) received a pass out of defence and immediately attempted a long-range shot, but a defender bravely blocked the effort.
24' A pass by Remo Freuler (Bologna) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
22' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
21' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
20' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) drills a powerful shot from long range towards the middle of the goal, but Marco Carnesecchi makes a comfortable save.
18' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) attempts to find Ademola Lookman, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.

16' The ball rebounds to Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) around the penalty spot and he produces a header towards the goal. Unfortunately for him, one of the defenders prevents the ball from ending in the net.
15' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) dribbles his way to the edge of the box and drills a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Lukasz Skorupski is equal to the effort and makes a good save.
14' Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) has tested the patience of referee Federico La Penna and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
12' Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) has an effort on goal, but he misses to the right of the goal.

11' Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly over the crossbar.
11' Now Bologna have a corner.
11' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
9' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
9' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Federico La Penna has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
8' Some patient build-up play from Atalanta as they look to unlock the defence.
6' Stefan Posch (Bologna) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
4' Stefan Posch (Bologna) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
2' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) receives a lofted pass from the side and shoots from around the penalty spot, but the ball flies slightly over, almost brushing the crossbar.
